text.en:
The Executive Committee of the NSC is hereby
reconstituted and shall be composed of the following:
President as Chairperson;
b. Vice-President;
Senate President or his representative;
Speaker of the House of Representatives or his representative;
e. Executive Secretary;
National Security Adviser;
g. Secretary of Foreign Affairs;
Secretary of Justice;
!.
Secretary of National Defense; and
Secretary of the Interior and Local Government,
and such other members or advisers as the President may designate
from time to time.
The Executive Committee shall review national security issues and
concerns and formulate positions or solutions for consideration by the
NSC. It shall determine the agenda and order of business of the NSC,
and shall ensure that decisions of the NSC are clearly communicated to

the agencies concerned.
implementation of decisions.
It shall advise the President on the
To carry out its functions, the Executive Committee may utilize the
facilities and expertise of any of the government agencies and
instrumentalities, and promulgate rules and regulations to govern its
operations.

The NSC shall be an advisory body to the President.
The National Security Adviser shall ensure that the policies formulated
by the NSC and approved by the President are effectively and efficiently
implemented.

Executive Order No. 33 dated November 18, 1992 is
hereby modified accordingly. All other orders, rules, regulations and
issuances, or parts thereof, which are inconsistent with this Executive
Order, are hereby repealed or likewise modified accordingly.

This Executive Order shall take effect immediately
upon approval.
City of Manila, September 17, 2001.
By the President:
Cither en. 6 G. Rommele
ALBERTO G. ROMULO
Executive Secretary
